notes: Uczelnie.pl says its displayed percentages are the ratio of the reported threshold to the scale used for that institution. Do not interpret percentages as matura-result percentages or compare scales across universities.

UEW Economics is listed as 180/350 for 2025/26, while the official UEW source represented in src/data/uew.json reports 170 for the same programme and year. Exclude the portal value pending clarification of the scale and underlying measure.
Do not map the UEW portal row named Stosunki Międzynarodowe to UEW's distinct programme Międzynarodowe stosunki gospodarcze.
The inspected pages expose only each programme's latest known entry, not a readable 2022/23–2024/25 history. Search snippets and page titles are not evidence for those years.
No programme offer, duration, language, or 2027/28 admission rule is established by these threshold listing pages. UEW duration remains unknown/null.
